omission_details.existing_body_proposition:
Pharmacist가 모든 성인 opioid 처방에 대해 일생 최초 사용 여부를 별도로 조사해야 한다는 새로운 universal duty를 이 조문만으로 만들어내지 않는다. Prescriber의 법정 의무, pharmacist의 corresponding responsibility, 사실관계상 확인이 필요한 임상적 우려를 구별한다.

근거: [M.G.L. c.94C §19D(a)–(c)](https://malegislature.gov/Laws/GeneralLaws/PartI/TitleXV/Chapter94C/Section19D); [M.G.L. c.94C §23(d)](https://malegislature.gov/Laws/GeneralLaws/PartI/TitleXV/Chapter94C/Section23); [247 CMR 9.15(2)](https://www.mass.gov/doc/247-cmr-9-professional-practice-standards/download). 확인일2026-11-03. 게시 법문을 확인했으며 이 검토에서 개별 statutory amendment의 시행일 이력 전체를 확정하지는 않았습니다.

entry_text.title: Opioid 7일의 대상
entry_text.core: Adult first outpatient opioid와 minor opioid의 기본 제한을 구분합니다.
entry_text.why: 예외의 clinical judgment·문서화와 OUD 치료의 별도 취급을 함께 읽습니다.
entry_text.trap: 모든 성인의 모든 subsequent opioid를 무조건 7일로 제한하지 않습니다.
entry_text.recall: 7-day prescribing 제한과 CII/CIII single-fill 상한을 분리하세요.

question_scope_evidence.stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacy reviews PMP-related obligations. Distinguish account registration, clinical queries, dispensing-data submission, and identification at pickup. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

options_and_scope.option_text: A pharmacist completes DUR and authenticity review separately from the PMP query.
A pharmacist substitutes an absent patient’s stored identifier without evaluating the actual collecting agent requirement.
A pharmacist keeps a patient-care query within the permitted purpose and access role.
A pharmacist distinguishes a prescriber’s mandatory-query trigger from the pharmacy’s duty to submit dispensing data.
A pharmacist dispensing reportable drugs maintains the required PMP account and login information.

question_scope_evidence.stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacy reviews PMP-related obligations. Distinguish account registration, clinical queries, dispensing-data submission, and identification at pickup. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

options_and_scope.option_text: A pharmacist recognizes gabapentin as Massachusetts Schedule VI with additional PMP obligations.
A pharmacy changes the actual prescribed directions while correcting an unrelated PMP transmission field, without the required prescription authorization.
A pharmacist shares PMP login credentials with a coworker to avoid that coworker’s required access controls.
A pharmacist treats the pharmacy’s automated reporting software as replacing the pharmacist’s required PMP account.
